prompt:
A high-fidelity design comp of a desktop website home page. The browser viewport fills the frame edge to edge: no browser chrome, no device frame, no desk, no hands, no poster mounting.

LAYOUT, stated top to bottom. (1) A slim album-yellow header bar across the full width, black rule beneath it, with ADAM WORLEY hand-lettered small at the left and four plain navigation words at the right. (2) The remainder of the page is composed as a strict comic album page with a four-tier panel grid, every panel bounded by the same even black line with a narrow paper-white gutter between them. Tier one is ONE wide establishing panel spanning the full width at about forty percent of the page height: a clear-line illustration of a desk seen from behind the chair, a man shown only from behind at his keyboard, two monitors, a window beyond with a London skyline of cranes and towers under a sky-blue sky. An album-yellow caption box sits in that panel upper left reading ADAM WORLEY, SOFTWARE ENGINEER. A white speech balloon sits lower right reading OVER A DECADE IN C SHARP. (3) Tier two is three equal panels side by side: a steel-blue server rack, an infrastructure diagram of boxes and connecting lines, and an office building facade, each with a small album-yellow caption box in its corner. (4) Tier three is four narrower panels in a row acting as project links, each a small illustrated scene with a caption strip beneath: a dog on a lead, a city office tower, an aircraft hangar, a writing desk. (5) Tier four is a short wide closing panel with an adventure-red button shape reading HELLO AT ADAMWORLEY DOT COM.

STYLE: ligne claire clear-line comic album artwork. One even unvarying black outline on every single shape, flat unmodulated colour fills, absolutely no gradients, no cast shadows, no shading, no texture, no photorealism, no 3D. Strict palette: sky blue, sand ochre, album yellow, paper white, sea green, steel blue, and one adventure red used sparingly for the single most important element. Headings hand-lettered in upright capitals; body text in clean small legible capitals. Every panel equally crisply drawn, a harbour crane as legible as a teacup.
approvalNote: Approved as the governing structure: four-tier album page. Tier one adopts comp B (.impeccable/mocks/comp-b-establishing-shot.png) for scale and calm - a wide full-width establishing scene with the name lettered over it. Comp B approved for hero scale only, not for its hero-plus-cards topology. Personal material gets its own full tier of panels.
